facts.fact: The document is the 'Final draft' of the ICT and Digital Economy Masterplan for South Africa, dated 22 February 2021 and authored by Genesis Analytics and Knowledge Executive.

facts.fact: The final draft contains a Priority Action Plan (section 6) with an appendix listing its actions, some with named executors and time limits such as three or five years; no costing is seen in the passages held.
